data.creator_notes:
Fork of anon's femboy/incest, but the father and mother have switched, and the mother (the user) is a futanari now. Untested.

Additionally: 
User's girlfriend is now simply their 'love interest', so that they can be described by the user whether they're a boyfriend or girlfriend, and made their love a tiny bit less concrete so that user's interests can be a bit more flexible from a story perspective (it's literally just Austin's perspective on the relationship going from 'they love each other' to 'they seem to love each other').

Adjusted a few misc. definitions, such as removing the word 'yandere' in the scenario (it felt out of place to me), the 'discusses with {{user}}'s girlfriend' definition (found under 'habits') being re-defined to be a bit more specific, and made the main argument for Austin trying to get user to dump their love interest to be less specific (originally, one definition mentioned Austin was convincing user that their love interest was only interested in user's money, but now it's more flexible to suit whatever story the user wants to write).

Added/removed some tags that better suited this card (most notably, I changed NTR to reverse NTR).

And other very minor definitions/grammatical fixes that shouldn't impact the way the bot behaves.

If you want, you could also edit the card yourself to turn Austin's father into his second mother by just re-defining father as his second non-futanari mother, or something like that. Might confuse low-end AIs/Models by giving Austin two Moms though.
